A.position: Existing native EEG encoder weights, keep final LayerNorm affine fixed; no new inference module
A.dropout: Off during this deterministic generator fine-tuning phase; original25epoch parent training unchanged
A.positive_energy: Per-query mean epsilon prediction squared error at same realT latent/noise/time
A.negative: EEG from the next different stimulus of the SAME T concept; no test labels at inference
A.temperature: Once on fixed256 T queries from64 concepts: max(RMS of native paired energy differences,1e-4); shared across all A arms
A.positive_control: Same two forward/backward graphs, contrastive term multiplied by0
A.reverse_control: Keep correct Lpos anchor; reverse ONLY the contrastive energy assignment
A.proved_invariance_scope: An additive energy term independent of EEG cancels in Lpos-Lneg; no claim of removing every common feature or exact posterior likelihood

B.position: Native first input projection; freeze original17-electrode projection/residual MLP/output affine
B.statistics: T EEG only: per-channel/time mean and shared spatial covariance pooled over T and time
B.residual_is_not: Not proven independent EEG information, physiological noise or source localization
B.raw_control: Same U and objective, B=0, use centered extra electrodes
B.shuffle_control: During T fitting only, feed same-concept wrong stimulus residual with correct posterior EEG; normal evaluation uses each query own63-electrode EEG
B.objective: Original positive epsilon MSE +0.1 native token error

common.ordinary: Preserve historical weights. Use only the newly matched sub03 ordinary as an explicitly frozen postprocessor interaction test, not a newly refitted ordinary for changed encoders.
common.inference: Own queryEEG only; no targetimage, label, caption or gallery; native512x512,4steps,CFG0,IP1,oneimage/query
common.Dfit: No encoder optimization or checkpoint selection; original fixed final ordinary calibration only
common.Dcheck: All83 concepts/all830 queries of sub03 planned; parent,matchedordinary,eachcandidate with/without frozenordinary; report all image/encoder metrics, no single-metric stop
common.engineering_prefix: First2 updates percase count toward827; actual GPU memory/gradient/input identity and CPU model/Adam/RNG/coverage checks before remaining fit
common.finite_execution: PerGPUjob20minutes, safe stop around1000seconds, bounded queue and exact retained state; never interpret a safe prefix as completed fit

novelty.not_claimed: Contrastive diffusion, ridge regression, Schur complement and linear folding are existing ideas; adaptation alone is not a publication contribution
novelty.required_evidence: Correct-pair/extra-EEG mechanisms must beat matched controls and strong image baselines, explain metric tradeoffs and survive larger subject/protocol validation
